::: {.remark .notes}

In general, uncorrelated random variables need not be independent
([an example](variance-covariance.qmd#exm-uncorrelated-not-indpt)).
@cor-mvn-uncorrelated-indpt needs the whole vector to be multivariate normal:
two random variables that are each normal and uncorrelated
can still be dependent
(<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normally_distributed_and_uncorrelated_does_not_imply_independent>).

:::
